messages:
ash: Heads-up — saw a sharp spike of 504s hitting /v1/embeddings for one tenant between 13:02-13:12 UTC. Traffic looks like a single client doing very large batches over one persistent HTTP/2 conn. sample trace ids: tid=0a1b2c3d, tid=0a1b2c3e :

maya: Got it. Any repro steps or request examples we can use locally?

ash: Repro is fairly consistent. Customer sent ~1200 items in one POST (total payload ~26MB) with keepalive and no chunking. Quick curl that imitates it:
```
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": ["...large array..."]}' \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embeddings
```
When we replay with --http2-prior-knowledge and one connection we reproduce 504s on the edge (envoy/ingress) ~10-20% of requests.

ops-bot: Alert: edge-ingress-504-rate high (policy: 5m window). incident:INC-20278

sre-oncall: Logs show upstream resets from frontdoor to midproxy. Example from frontdoor:
```
[W] upstream reset reason=STREAM_RESET code=CANCEL trace=0a1b2c3d
```
Also seeing long queuing on envoys at the keepalive connection: stream slots exhausted.

jun: I looked at NGINX/Envoy connpool metrics — the connection has max concurrent streams ~= 100 and we see >90 active streams for a long tail. Upstream connection-window starvation. When one tenant pins many streams on one conn we starve other inbound streams and some get reset/time out.

maya: Any recent config changes on frontdoor or midproxy? Canary rollback candidate?

emily: We rolled a tiny change to the HTTP/2 settings yesterday (increase max_concurrent_streams to 128) but nothing obvious. Can we try forcing smaller concurrent streams per conn as a quick mitigation? Also can we throttle per-connection stream creation for a tenant?

ash: Short-term mitigation applied: set per-conn max_concurrent_streams=32 on the midproxy pool for that shard and added tenant-level concurrent request cap. After that 504 rate dropped from 18% -> 2% in 10m. Customer still able to send large batch but it's slower and more reliable.

jun: Repro notes: if you replay same payload but split into chunks of ~200 items (client-side chunking) we no longer hit 504s. So we should ask customer to chunk while we work on infra fix.

sre-oncall: Follow-ups: (1) add metric for per-connection stream occupancy, (2) implement adaptive throttling on frontdoor to detect long-lived high-stream conns and rebalance, (3) add a customer-facing best-practice doc for large-embed batching. filing PRs and tickets.

ash: Filed support ticket to the customer with repro + chunking workaround and ETA for infra changes. Will update here when infra PR merges. :thumbsup:

support-bot: INC-20278 updated: state=mitigated assignee=sre-oncall

emily: Nice work. Once PR is merged we'll run a canary to ensure no regression in small-request latency.
